Job Requirements

Do you want to help create the future of healthcare? Our name, Siemens Healthineers, was selected to honor our people who dedicate their energy and passion to this cause. It reflects their pioneering spirit combined with our long history of engineering in the ever-evolving healthcare industry.

We offer you a flexible and dynamic environment with opportunities to go beyond your comfort zone in order to grow personally and professionally. Sounds interesting?

Then come and join our global team as 4D ICE (Intracardiac Echocardiography) and Interventional Ultrasound EMEA - Clinical Application Specialist (f/m/d) to drive the adoption of one of the most innovative imaging technologies in Structural Heart and Electrophysiology.

In this role, you will collaborate closely with internationally recognized physicians, Key Opinion Leaders, and leading global partners in the Structural Heart and Electrophysiology space. You will support a broad range of advanced procedures, including transcatheter valve interventions, left atrial appendage (LAA) closure, electrophysiology procedures, and emerging therapies. At the same time, you will help shape the future of interventional imaging by incorporating direct customer feedback and driving clinical innovation in one of the fastest-growing fields of cardiovascular medicine.

Choose the best place for your work - Within the scope of this position, it is possible, in consultation with your manager, to work mobile (within Germany) up to an average volume of 60% of the respective working hours.

Even more flexibility? Mobile working from abroad is possible for up to 30 days a year under certain conditions and in selected countries.

This position can be filled within Germany.

Your tasks and responsibilities:

Drive Clinical Adoption
* You lead the successful clinical adoption of AcuNav Lumos 4D ICE and Interventional Ultrasound technologies across EMEA.
* You support physicians and cath lab/EP teams by providing expert clinical and technical guidance during procedures and enabling the effective use of the AcuNav Lumos 4D ICE Catheter and interventional ultrasound technologies.

Develop Education and Training
* You create and deliver high-quality training programs and educational content for customers as well as internal commercial and clinical teams, while maintaining deep expertise in the clinical application of intracardiac echocardiography.
* You support major international congresses, customer events, and educational initiatives across EMEA, including hands-on workshops, simulation training, and clinical demonstrations.

Collaborate Across the Structural Heart Ecosystem
* You work closely with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), build trusted relationships, and act as the voice of the customer by gathering clinical insights and supporting continuous product improvement.
* You partner with commercial, marketing, product management, and R&D teams to share clinical feedback and contribute to ongoing innovation and product development.

Support Commercial Success
* You provide clinical expertise to identify customer needs and collaborate with commercial teams to drive successful adoption and account growth.
* You contribute to go-to-market initiatives and customer engagement strategies.

To find out more about the specific business, have a look at Ultrasound

Your qualifications and experience:
* You hold a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Medical Technology, Biomedical Engineering, Nursing, or a related discipline.
* You have many years of hands-on clinical experience in echocardiography, interventional cardiology, structural heart interventions, and/or electrophysiology within the medical technology industry.
* Do you already have many years of sound professional experience e.g. as clinical application specialist or Cath Lab Nurse and further qualifications in this field, but no degree? Then we also look forward to receiving your application.
* You possess strong expertise in advanced cardiac imaging, including solid knowledge of TEE, 3D/4D echocardiography and preferably ICE.
* You have a proven track record of delivering impactful product demonstrations, providing clinical education, and leading physician training sessions in complex clinical environments.
* You bring expert knowledge of clinical procedures, workflow optimization, best practices, troubleshooting techniques, scientific literature, emerging technologies, and competitive developments.

Your attributes and skills:
* You thrive in an international matrix organization, can effectively manage multiple priorities, and communicate fluently in English; German language skills are a strong advantage.
* You have a strong ability to understand customer needs, translate clinical insights into actionable recommendations, and effectively communicate them to commercial and cross-functional teams.
* With excellent communication and interpersonal skills, you build trusted relationships with physicians, Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), and other stakeholders, and are able to educate, influence, and drive collaboration.
* You are self-motivated, curious, and solution-oriented, with a passion for innovation, continuous learning, and improving patient care.
* In addition, you are willing and able to travel extensively within your area of responsibility (approximately 80%).

Our global team:

Siemens Healthineers is a leading global medical technology company. 74,000 dedicated colleagues in over 70 countries are driven to shape the future of healthcare. An estimated 5 million patients across the globe benefit every day from our innovative technologies and services in the areas of diagnostic and therapeutic imaging, laboratory diagnostics and molecular medicine, as well as digital health and enterprise services.

Our culture embraces different perspectives, open debate, and the will to challenge convention. Change is a constant aspect of our work. We aspire to lead the change in our industry rather than just react to it. That's why we invite you to take on new challenges, test your ideas, and celebrate success. Check our Career Site.

Postdoctoral Researcher (m/f/d) – Experimental Cancer Neuroscience

Full- or part-time | temporary (36 months) | Klinik und Poliklinik für Chirurgie

We are seeking an exceptional and highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to join our internationally active research group at the interface of cancer biology, neuroscience and tumor immunology.
Our group investigates how the nervous system shapes tumor initiation, progression, invasion, metastasis and cancer-associated symptoms, with a particular focus on pancreatic cancer and cancer neuroscience. We combine mechanistic cancer biology with neuroscience, immunology, advanced in vivo models, spatial and single-cell technologies, functional imaging and translational human studies.
Our ambition is clear: to define and lead emerging concepts in cancer neuroscience rather than merely follow them.
The laboratory operates in a highly competitive and well-funded environment with support from, among others, the European Research Council (ERC), Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG), Deutsche Krebshilfe and Else Kröner-Fresenius-Stiftung, and is embedded in a strong national and international network in cancer neuroscience.

Your responsibilities:

The successful candidate will take a central scientific role in our experimental program and will contribute to the conception, execution and development of ambitious projects addressing neural–tumor–immune interactions.

Depending on expertise, projects may include:

- mechanistic studies of neuron–cancer and neuro–immune interactions
- functional characterization of neural signaling pathways in cancer
- genetically engineered and orthotopic in vivo tumor models
- manipulation of neuronal, immune and tumor-cell populations
- advanced imaging and molecular phenotyping
- integration of molecular, cellular and spatial data with functional experiments
- development of new experimental concepts and therapeutic strategies in cancer neuroscience

A particularly important aspect of the position is the strategic management and further development of our animal experimentation platform.

This may include:

- preparation and coordination of animal study applications and amendments
- planning and supervision of complex in vivo experiments
- establishment and optimization of experimental mouse models
- management of genetically modified mouse colonies
- breeding strategy, genotyping and colony planning
- coordination with animal facilities, authorities and collaborating laboratories
- implementation of high standards in experimental design, documentation and animal welfare

Your profile:

We are looking for a scientist with a strong experimental background in at least one – preferably several – of the following fields: Cancer Biology | Tumor Immunology | Neuroscience | Neuroimmunology | Molecular Biology

You should have:

- a PhD or equivalent doctoral degree in a relevant life-science discipline
- substantial hands-on experience in experimental biomedical research as well as experience with in vivo models, ideally tumor models and/or neuroscience models
- strong expertise in molecular and cellular biology and the ability to independently design, troubleshoot and drive complex experiments
- excellent scientific communication skills in English
- a highly collaborative but intellectually independent working style

Particularly desirable is extensive experience with:

- animal experimentation and experimental planning and preparation or management of animal experimentation applications
- genetically engineered mouse models as well as mouse breeding and colony management
- tumor models and neuroscience or neuroimmunology techniques

We offer you:

- This is not intended to be a purely technical postdoctoral position.
- We offer the opportunity to become a scientifically visible and intellectually independent member of a rapidly developing research program, with substantial room to shape projects and develop an individual research profile. 
- Our goal is to attract scientists who want to build a field, not simply complete a project.
- You will work in an internationally competitive cancer neuroscience environment; ERC-, DFG-, Deutsche Krebshilfe- and foundation-funded research programs; highly interdisciplinary collaborations spanning cancer biology, neuroscience, immunology, surgery, pathology, spatial biology and computational biology
- We offe you projects with strong potential for high-impact publications and a translational environment with direct access to human cancer material and clinically relevant questions as well as an international network of leading scientists in the emerging field of Cancer Neuroscience
- EGYM well pass, corporate benefits and discounts (e.g. Käfer), cafeteria, sports and cultural offers
- Working in the heart of Munich at Max-Weber-Platz with very good accessibility by public transport such as the subway, S-Bahn or tram 

We look forward to meeting you!

A Snapshot of Your Day 

As an Industrial Cybersecurity Expert (f/m/d) you will help strengthen cybersecurity across manufacturing OT (Operational Technologies) environments. You will work in a global setting, collaborating daily with colleagues from multiple countries. Using your IT/OT security expertise, you will support, consult, and guide factory teams on cybersecurity topics. You will help shape secure manufacturing principles and contribute to the development of secure IT and OT infrastructures. This will play a key role in addressing cybersecurity needs across manufacturing environments.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Define secure manufacturing principles and support the development of secure manufacturing IT and OT infrastructure
* Translate IT/OT governance policies and controls into practical implementation measures for manufacturing environments
* Define cybersecurity requirements and demands from factories and ensure they are addressed effectively
* Specify and maintain configuration and hardening guidelines for our products, third-party components, and manufacturing equipment
* Collaborate with functions such as GT ICS, SE CYS/IT, and Digitalization GPO to help secure manufacturing, production, and product development environments, and provide guidance and documentation support throughout development and engineering processes.

What You Bring

* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT Security, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering with a focus on IT Security, or similar experience in IT and OT environments
* Many years of experience in Industrial Cybersecurity / IT Security
* Knowledge of manufacturing infrastructure and IT/OT security technologies and concepts, including IIoT, Connected Factory environments, OT hardware, and sensors
* Experience with risk-based approaches such as threat and risk analysis, as well as incident and vulnerability handling
* Understanding of international or national IT/OT security standards, regulations, and related legal considerations
* Very good, user-focused communication skills both in German and English, a value- and solution-driven mindset, and experience in stakeholder management

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.  

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical 

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.
